title: Penguin Solutions Recognized as Dell Technologies Global Alliances Americas AI Partner of the Year
summary: Award highlights Penguin’s expertise in delivering Full-Stack AI Factory Platforms that address the growing demand for optimized large-scale inference and agentic AI workloads Penguin Solutions , Inc. (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that it has been recognized as the 2026 Dell Technologies Global Alliances Americas AI Partner of the Year. The prestigious award, presented at Dell Technologies World during the Global Partner Alliance event, underscores Penguin Solutions’ proven success in delivering Full-Stack AI Factory Platforms that combine differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory technologies, compute systems, and services with Dell Technologies' AI-optimized infrastructure solutions. Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.
